# SolarWindPy Documentation

This directory contains the Sphinx documentation for SolarWindPy.

## Building Documentation

### Prerequisites
```bash
pip install -e ".[docs]"  # from the repository root
```

### Local Build
```bash
make html
```

The built documentation will be available in `build/html/index.html`.

### Clean Build
```bash
make clean
make html
```

## Auto-Generated Files

API pages are generated by `sphinx.ext.autosummary` from `source/api_reference.rst`
into `source/_autosummary/` on every build. That directory is build output: it is
gitignored, and `make clean` removes it.

## Deployment

Documentation is automatically built and deployed to GitHub Pages via the `.github/workflows/docs.yml` workflow when changes are pushed to the `master` branch.
